external_entities.name: member
external_entities.description: A library member who borrows, renews and reserves books through the library app and uses branch kiosks.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

external_entities.name: desk staff
external_entities.description: Library desk staff who manually extend loans, clear account blocks and mark books as returned.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand
external_entities.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login; individual staff and branch cannot be identified from the history.

processes.name: library app
processes.description: The app on a member's phone through which members borrow, renew and reserve books by calling the lending API.
processes.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

processes.name: lending API
processes.description: The REST API that is the sole interface for reading and writing loans and serves the circulation page.
processes.source_excerpt: It's a REST API. JSON in, JSON out.
processes.notes: Priya said she thinks the API checks a token obtained by the app at sign-in, but was unsure and could not say what the API accepts or does with rejected calls.

processes.name: kiosk
processes.description: A self-service branch kiosk where a member scans a library card and books being borrowed or returned.
processes.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.

data_stores.name: loans database
data_stores.description: The single database containing members, loans, reservations, names, email addresses, home addresses and full borrowing histories.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database.
data_stores.notes: Priya corrected the earlier description of two databases: the reservations database was merged into this one and is gone.

data_flows.name: borrow book
data_flows.description: A member uses the library app to request that the lending API record a book loan.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.
data_flows.data_description: Member and book details for a borrowing request.

data_flows.name: renew loan
data_flows.description: A member uses the library app to request that the lending API renew a loan.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API. It says which book and which member, and the API checks the loan rules and writes the change.
data_flows.notes: The speaker said she thinks the app obtains a token at sign-in, but explicitly expressed uncertainty about the API's authentication behavior.
data_flows.data_description: Member and book details for a loan renewal.

data_flows.name: reserve title
data_flows.description: A member uses the library app to request that the lending API place them in a queue for a title.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Reserving is the same shape, the app asks for a title and the API puts the member in the queue for it.
data_flows.notes: The speaker said she thinks the app obtains a token at sign-in, but explicitly expressed uncertainty about the API's authentication behavior.
data_flows.data_description: Member and title details for a reservation.

data_flows.name: send loan
data_flows.description: A kiosk sends a scanned loan to the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks send each loan and each return to the lending API.
data_flows.data_description: A member, book and loan transaction.

data_flows.name: send return
data_flows.description: A kiosk sends a scanned book return to the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.
data_flows.data_description: A member, book and return transaction.

data_flows.name: extend loan
data_flows.description: Desk staff use the circulation page served by the lending API to extend a loan.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand, through a circulation page the lending API serves.
data_flows.notes: All desk staff use one shared circulation-page login; the password is on a card taped under the desk.
data_flows.data_description: A member loan and its extension.

data_flows.name: clear block
data_flows.description: Desk staff use the circulation page served by the lending API to clear a block on a member account.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When a member says they returned a book and the record says they did not, someone at the desk opens the circulation page and marks it returned, or clears the block on the account.
data_flows.notes: All desk staff use one shared circulation-page login; the password is on a card taped under the desk.
data_flows.data_description: A member account block and its clearance.

data_flows.name: mark returned
data_flows.description: Desk staff use the circulation page served by the lending API to mark a book as returned by hand.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand
data_flows.notes: The history records that the loan was closed by hand, but not which person or branch performed the action. All desk staff use one shared circulation-page login.
data_flows.data_description: A member loan and its manual return status.

data_flows.name: read and write loans
data_flows.description: The lending API reads from and writes to the loans database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API is the only thing that reads or writes it.
data_flows.data_description: Members, loans, reservations and associated personal details.

trust_boundaries.name: branch network
trust_boundaries.description: The network on which branch kiosks operate and desk staff work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The kiosks sit on the branch network.

trust_boundaries.name: council data centre
trust_boundaries.description: The council data-centre zone where the lending API and loans database run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The lending API and the loans database run in the council data centre.

assumptions.assumption: The lending API presents a web interface because the text identifies it as a REST API.
assumptions.basis: The interview states, "It's a REST API. JSON in, JSON out." The model's interface-kind definition classifies REST APIs as web interfaces.

assumptions.assumption: The loans database contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: The interview states that the database contains names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history; disclosure of personal data is confidential.
